A '''Tropical Wiggler''' in ''[[Super Mario Odyssey]]''. |parent_species= [[Wiggler]] |first_appearance=''[[Super Mario Odyssey]]'' ([[List of games by date#2017|2017]]) }} '''Tropical Wigglers'''[https://i.imgur.com/kWVFLbT.jpg Kingdom Brochures] are long, colorful [[Wiggler]] variants resembling inchworms wearing floppy purple hats. They first appear in ''[[Super Mario Odyssey]]'', where they appear in the [[Lost Kingdom]] and the Underground Moon Caverns in the [[Moon Kingdom]].IGN Walkthroughs. October 26, 2017. [https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=OVkKnJ5rgBM Super Mario Odyssey Walkthrough - Underground Moon Caverns (Part 33)]. ''YouTube''. Retrieved October 27, 2017. They are not aggressive, and are in fact described with such terms as "genial" and "pleasant"; however, their spiked bodies can still cause them to unwittingly damage Mario. They move by stretching their bodies outward before contracting, much like an inchworm. They often do this across pathways; this, combined with their coloration, has earned them the nickname "traffic lights of the island." Mario is capable of [[capture|capturing]] it to travel over the [[Poisoned Water]] or [[lava]] that fills the area, but it can be defeated by having it fall into a pit of Poison Water or lava or by throwing a hammer at it as a [[Hammer Bro]], like it can be seen in the Moon Kingdom. ==Names in other languages== {{foreign names |Jap=シマハナチャン
